# TEST FIXTURE — a frozen copy of deck 96 (Glarb) taken 2026-11-05 for tests/test_builder*.py.
# Not a roster deck (it lives outside decks/). Counterspell and Dictate of Kruphix are IN it;
# Krang, Murder and Opt are OUT. Never edit it to track the live deck — that is the point.
#: name: Drowned Library
#: format: Historic Brawl
#: colors: BGU
#: commander: Glarb, Calamity's Augur
#: plan: control
#: archetype: 100-card Brawl (Arena's "Brawl" queue, Historic card pool), SULTAI DRAW-TO-MILL CONTROL around
#: archetype: Glarb, Calamity's Augur: "you may look at the top card of your library any time", "you may play lands
#: archetype: and cast spells with mana value 4 or greater from the top of your library" and "{T}: Surveil 2". The
#: archetype: deck wins by emptying the opponent's library. Every card we DRAW mills them: the two Tutelages
#: archetype: turn draws into mill 2, Bruvac doubles any mill, The Water Crystal adds four, Fraying Sanity repeats a
#: archetype: turn's graveyard total at end step. Glarb's surveil is the draw engine's spark — Matoya draws on every
#: archetype: surveil/scry, Malcolm loots on every hit — and The Theorist, Defiler of Dreams and fourteen
#: archetype: planeswalkers keep the draws coming, Krang doubling the triggers. The finishers are big mills
#: archetype: (Terisian Mindbreaker's attack or unearth, Cut Your Losses, Riverchurn Monument, Jace, the Perfected Mind's −X) and
#: archetype: repeated library EXILE (three Ashioks), with Lithoform Engine copying the big turns; many are mana value 4+, so Glarb casts
#: archetype: them straight off the top. Their milled graveyard is a resource: Drown in the Loch scales with it,
#: archetype: Yawgmoth's Vile Offering reanimates from it, Villainous Wealth casts from their library, Consuming
#: archetype: Aberration grows with it. DISTINCT from deck 22 (Dimir Standard mill-control, Hama + the
#: archetype: Water Crystal): this is a 100-card Sultai draw engine whose mill is a by-product of drawing.
#: protect: Glarb, Calamity's Augur; Bruvac the Grandiloquent; Matoya, Archon Elder; Sphinx's Tutelage; Ashiok, Nightmare Muse; Jace, Memory Adept; Sheoldred, the Apocalypse; Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim; The Theorist, Jace Beleren
#: notes: DRAFTED 2026-11-01 with /draft-deck from the Sultai pile analysis (owner's pick 2 of 2: draw + mill/exile
#: notes: under Glarb; pick 1 is 75-historic-brawl). The optimal list, crafts included. Brawl is 1v1 at 25 life with
#: notes: a ~92-card library after the opening hand, so mill needs ~90 cards: a doubler plus one big mill does it.
#: notes: Symmetric draw (Dictate of Kruphix, CUT in the 2026-11-03 trim) was deliberate — every card the opponent draws is a card off the clock.
#: notes: DRAFT SWAPS: Ashiok, Dream Render was CUT before commit — its −1 exiles the opponent's graveyard, which
#: notes: Consuming Aberration and Sheoldred's transform need full (G-42); The Master of Lake-town took the slot
#: notes: (with Sheoldred, the Apocalypse every opposing draw mills two). Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Theorix Charm
#: notes: replaced Talisman of Resilience and Thought Scour. Lands kept as drafted: swapping the unconditional
#: notes: taplands for basics left as-built on-curve flat (48.6% → 48.5%); only cutting Jidoor gained (+1.2), and
#: notes: Jidoor's Overture mills half a library from a land slot. The surveil lands feed Matoya (and fed Proft, CUT 2026-11-03).
#: notes: BENCH at draft (screened KEY, not in the first list): Memory Deluge and Fleet Swallower; Chandra, Jace,
#: notes: Wielder of Mysteries, Visions of Beyond, Cut Your Losses and Phenax were added later. PARKED VARIANT from
#: notes: the pile analysis: Maralen, Fae Ascendant + Elves + theft (every Elf entering exiles two of their library;
#: notes: the free cast is capped by the Elf/Faerie count, so it needs 8–10 cheap nonlegendary Elves from outside).
#: notes: LANDS (owner, 2026-11-03): four Islands became Waterlogged Grove, Barkchannel Pathway, Willowrush Verge and
#: notes: Gloomlake Verge — G 15→18, B 20→21, U unchanged at 24; Glarb on curve 63.7%→69.8%, none of the four enters tapped.
#: notes: Opulent Palace for a Swamp was measured too (Glarb 71.9%) and left out: its tapped entry cost back most of the gain.
